<style> /* Skinning standard WooCommerce 'Related Products' output */ 
.stillness-dynamic-related-container ul.products { display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr) !important; gap: 32px !important; list-style: none !important; padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; }
.stillness-dynamic-related-container ul.products::before, .stillness-dynamic-related-container ul.products::after { content: none !important; }
@media (max-width: 1024px) { .stillness-dynamic-related-container ul.products { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important; gap: 24px !important; } }
@media (max-width: 640px) { .stillness-dynamic-related-container ul.products { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; gap: 32px !important; } }
.stillness-dynamic-related-container li.product { display: flex !important; flex-direction: column !important; width: 100% !important; float: none !important; margin: 0 !important; cursor: pointer; list-style-type: none !important; }
.stillness-dynamic-related-container li.product a.woocommerce-LoopProduct-link { display: flex !important; flex-direction: column !important; text-decoration: none !important; color: inherit !important; }
.stillness-dynamic-related-container li.product img { width: 100% !important; aspect-ratio: 4/5 !important; object-fit: cover !important; border-radius: 12px !important; transition: transform 0.7s ease-out !important; margin-bottom: 16px !important; background: rgba(196, 187, 180, 0.2) !important; }
.stillness-dynamic-related-container li.product:hover img { transform: scale(1.05) !important; }
.stillness-dynamic-related-container li.product .woocommerce-loop-product__title { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif !important; font-size: 20px !important; color: #0E1B30 !important; margin: 0 0 4px 0 !important; font-weight: 400 !important; transition: color 0.3s ease !important; order: 1; }
.stillness-dynamic-related-container li.product:hover .woocommerce-loop-product__title { color: #688F9D !important; }
.stillness-dynamic-related-container li.product .price { font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif !important; color: rgba(14,27,48,0.7) !important; font-size: 14px !important; order: 2; display: block !important; }
.stillness-dynamic-related-container li.product .button,  .stillness-dynamic-related-container li.product .added_to_cart { display: none !important; /* Hide 'Add to cart' buttons on the related grid per design */ }
</style>
